text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
All newspapers report on the meeting between Romanian President, Emil Constantinescu and Moldovan elected-president Petre Lucinski.
- State-owned Petrom oil company loses over 500 tonnes of crude oil a day due to bad weather.
- Motorists queue at petrol stations across the country following government decision to increase fuel prices starting January 1.
- The price of goods and services expected to rise starting January following the depreciation of the national leu currency and increases in fuel prices starting next year.
